tool.name: Datadog Agent Observability
tool.description: Datadog module for end-to-end tracing of LLM and agent apps, with cost/latency dashboards, quality clustering and sensitive-data redaction.
strengths: Correlates LLM spans with existing APM data
SDKs for Python, Node.js and Java
tool.pricing: From $160/month (annual) for the first 100k LLM spans at 15-day retention, then $3.50 per 10K LLM spans (annual; $5 on-demand). Longer retention costs more.
tool.statusNote: Datadog's docs now title the product "Agent Observability" and still use "LLM Observability" interchangeably. Not available on the US1-FED/US2-FED government sites (checked 2026-09-30).
tool.logoNotes: Fallback: no reviewed logo asset sourced yet.
tool.practitionerNote: Best fit for organisations already standardised on Datadog that want LLM traces next to infrastructure and APM data under existing audit and compliance controls. Span-based billing grows with agent step count, so model cost before instrumenting chatty multi-step agents.

dataResidency.detail: The customer picks a Datadog site: US1/US3/US5, EU1 (Germany), AP1 (Japan), AP2 (Australia) or UK1. The product is not supported on FED sites.

auditLogging.detail: Datadog Audit Trail records user activity, API requests and resource changes across the organisation.

soc2.detail: Datadog lists SOC 2 Type 2 on its Trust Center (company-wide; product-level scope not separately stated).

iso27001.detail: Datadog lists ISO/IEC 27001 (plus 27017, 27018 and 27701) on its Trust Center.

iso42001.detail: Datadog lists ISO/IEC 42001:2023 on its Trust Center (company-wide; module scope not separately stated).

euAiAct.detail: Monitoring tooling, not an AI system placed on the market. Obligations rest with the deployer of the monitored system.

licenseRisk.detail: Proprietary SaaS tied to the Datadog platform, with span-based metered billing.
